title: Prove structural nonexplosion while retaining the exponential-time cost
statement: For ANY finite mass-action network with at mostTWO molecules on EACH side and actual channel constants<=3/2,positive total-population increments have zero/unimolecular propensities; quadratic propensities cannot increaseN. Discarding negative changes gives Q(1+N)^j<=C_j(1+N)^j,C_j=6j3^j J. Stopped finite-state Dynkin/Gronwall andj1 yield vanishing O(n^-1) population-exit probability on finite horizons. On bounded-population sets total labelled intensity is bounded,so internal/null firings cannot accumulate. Hence ALL admitted independent coefficient choices are nonexplosive,without weak reversibility or an invariant law. Moreover E(1+N_T)^j<=(1+N0)^j exp(C_jT),and expected ALL firings<=3J(1+N0)^2/2 timesint_0^T exp(C2t)dt. These finite bounds are EXPONENTIAL in physicalT; they do not pay polynomialW full-cycle costs whenT is polynomialW,and do not imply perturbed positive recurrence or stationary accuracy.
